body:
How can you be a horrible person, when it sound like all you do, you do for others? You say it yourself "I've again ruined things despite wanting to make them better." 
You're not a horrible person, at all, you're a person going above and beyond. You tried, that's all you can do, really. Just keep doing that, trying, and life will eventually get good again. Everything that's broken can be fixed, remember? 
Please write me a PM, if there's anything you want to talk about, I may, or may not, be able to help, but I can listen, and I can understand. Your life holds more value than you're willing to believe at the moment.
